changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Workflow & Business Automation Playbook Generator.
- Provides 4 structured prompt templates to identify, design, and implement AI-driven workflow automation for businesses.
- Generates custom automation playbooks, tool recommendations, step-by-step SOPs, and ROI projections based on user inputs.
- Includes a detailed real-world example and actionable outputs to help users save time and cut costs without hiring a consultant.
- Additional done-for-you (DFY) upsell option for personalized automation playbook creation.
summary: Generates a custom AI automation playbook identifying workflows to automate, recommended tools, SOPs, and ROI projections for small businesses.
